Issue title: [vue-ts] ts compiler fails when handling input events in dom
Issue body excerpt: ### Describe the bug

When creating a project with the "vue-ts" template, the ts compiler is taking issue with the event-type of input-events.


### Reproduction

1) `yarn create @vitejs/app reproduce --template vue-ts`
2) add `<input type="text" @input="e => $emit('input', e.target.value)">` somewhere in the template
3) run `yarn build`

Fails with:

```
src/components/HelloWorld.vue:3:50 - error TS2531: Object is possibly 'null'.

3   <input type="text" @input="e => $emit('input', e.target.value)">
                                                   ~~~~~~~~

src/components/HelloWorld.vue:3:59 - error TS2339: Property 'value' does not exist on type 'EventTarget'.

3   <input type="text" @input="e => $emit('input', e.target.value)">
                                                            ~~~~~
```

Issue title: Vite Rejects Valid Range Request
Issue body excerpt: ### Describe the bug

When doing a range request on a tiff file, if the bytes request are longer than the length of the file, then a 416 "Range Not Satisfiable" error is returned by Vite.

The expected response is that all data within the range is returned, and the response is clipped to the length of the file.

In Chrome, the browser automatically clips the range request to the length of the file. In Firefox, a 416 "Range Not Satisfiable" error is returned by Vite.

This is request headers:

```
GET /asi-AMSR2-s6250-20220820-v5.4.tif HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:3000
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; rv:106.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/106.0
Accept: */*
Accept-Language: en-US,en;q=0.5
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br, identity
Referer: http://localhost:3000/
Range: bytes=40960-350880
Connection: keep-alive
Sec-Fetch-Dest: empty
Sec-Fetch-Mode: cors
Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin
```


This is the expected response (e.g. from Apache)

```
HTTP/1.1 206 Partial Content
Date: Tue, 01 Nov 2022 03:12:22 GMT
Server: Apache/2.4.41 (Ubuntu)
Last-Modified: Tue, 01 Nov 2022 03:12:19 GMT
ETag: "41f70-5ec6017907076"
Accept-Ranges: bytes
Content-Length: 229232
Content-Range: bytes 40960-270191/270192
Keep-Alive: timeout=5, max=98
Connection: Keep-Alive
Content-Type: image/tiff
```

This is the actual response in Firefox

```
HTTP/1.1 416 Range Not Satisfiable
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
Content-Range: bytes */270192
Date: Tue, 01 Nov 2022 03:05:59 GMT
Connection: keep-alive
Keep-Alive: timeout=5
Content-Length: 0
```

### Reproduction

https://github.com/anton-seaice/vite-range-requests

### Steps to reproduce

npm install
npm run dev

Look in the Console or Network tab in Web Developed Tools in Firefox

```shell
System:
    OS: Linux 5.4 Ubuntu 20.04
